veranderings.blok: Vier groepe, plus water en vesel
veranderings.voor: gee energie, en vette en olies soos botter ook.
veranderings.na: gee energie. Vette en olies soos botter gee ook energie.
veranderings.rede: The elliptical second half ('en vette en olies soos botter ook') has no verb, so the comma before 'en' does not follow the AWS rule; two complete sentences are clearer for Grade 6.

veranderings.blok: Genoeg, en nie te veel nie
veranderings.voor: Elke groep êrens op jou bord beteken nog nie balans nie.
veranderings.na: As elke groep êrens op jou bord is, beteken dit nog nie balans nie.
veranderings.rede: A noun phrase with a place adverbial as subject of 'beteken' is wooden; a conditional clause reads naturally.

veranderings.blok: Genoeg, en nie te veel nie
veranderings.voor: het kos nodig om mee te bou
veranderings.na: het kos nodig om sy liggaam mee te bou
veranderings.rede: 'om mee te bou' leaves the object of building vague; naming the body makes the clause complete without adding content.

veranderings.voor: Met 'n vrug en groente by is al vier groepe daar.
veranderings.na: As hy ook 'n vrug en groente eet, is al vier groepe daar.
veranderings.rede: 'Met ... by is' is clumsy; a conditional clause with Thabo as subject is more natural and keeps the meaning.
'die oorskot' names the extra energy precisely; 'die res' can read as the rest of the food.
After 'sonder', 'enigiets' is the idiomatic indefinite; 'van iets' sounds like a specific unnamed thing.
A condition one is in takes 'waarin'; 'waarby' is less idiomatic with 'toestand'.

veranderings.na: Skade wat die suur van kieme
veranderings.rede: The subject 'suur van kieme' needs the article to read as a clear noun phrase.

vlae.blok: Vier groepe, plus water en vesel
vlae.teks: Vitamiene en minerale uit vars vrugte en groente help jou gesond bly.
vlae.rede: Not a safety flag and not a language change: a protected entry says the lesson must not suggest vitamins and minerals come only from fruit and vegetables; this sentence names only that source, which a checker may want to look at. Left unchanged because fixing it would alter content.
